$comment: Member kinds this lexicon supplies to a chant workspace (#3179). chant reads this file as data and never imports the lexicon. A Helm chart is a directory with a Chart.yaml, and Chart.yaml is the member's own file, checked against schemas/chart.schema.json. No graph block yet: this lexicon renders charts it generates and has no reader for an existing one.
